text:
Type: plaid fringed throw blanket
Use: warmth and a cozy layer on a sofa, armchair or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: traditional, Scandinavian, farmhouse
Materials: soft brushed woven fabric, twisted fringe on the short ends
Colors: light grey, warm brown and charcoal check stripes, off-white
Shape: flat rectangular blanket with a tartan check pattern, long tasseled fringe along both ends, soft drape, light visual weight
Feel: cozy, warm, homey, relaxed
Goes with: grey or beige sofas, warm wood, wool and leather; traditional, cabin-style or Scandinavian living rooms
